title: Latest New York State Orthoimagery
description: Combination of multiple years of orthoimagery encompassing 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024. The service provides a Natural Color view at approximately 12 inch resolution. The source orthoimagery is 4-band at resolutions of 12 or 6 inches. For more information see https://gis.ny.gov/orthoimagery#statewide-status-overview. Please contact NYS ITS Geospatial Services at nysgis@its.ny.gov if you have any questions.
snippet: New York Statewide coverage of orthoimagery using the most recent versions.
accessInformation: NYS ITS Geospatial Services, Westchester County GIS
